title: WhoIsThis
tagline: A Social Identity Manager for Anonymous Web3 Public Addresses
description:
A Social Identity Manager for Anonymous Web3 Public Addresses!

It is a Dapp used for analyzing the web3 public wallet address

This shows that the user's Trust Score aggregates multiple on/off-chain sources of reputation into a singular graph where each source gets curated and counts towards some points too. 

These are further accessible as an overall dynamic TrustScore for any Ethereum Address. This score is continuously evolving. 

As more platforms get integrated, the weights and the score will update too.
how_its_made:
This project uses NFT-port API to fetch the address's NFT holdings

We used covalent API to fetch the address's ERC20 token holdings

We used POAP's API to fetch the address's POAP holdings

We implemented the Upvotes & Downvotes to enable the user to give public views toward any public address. This is powered by the Polygon PoS chain.

We have added a Chat option by which any user can anonymously contact or chat with each other by using XMTP Protocol
